properties.title: Flash Flood Warning issued August 23 at 10:55PM MST until August 24 at 1:30AM MST by NWS Tucson AZ
properties.description:
FFWTWC

The National Weather Service in Tucson has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
North Central Pima County in southeastern Arizona...
Southwestern Pinal County in southeastern Arizona...

* Until 130 AM MST.

* At 1055 PM MST, Doppler radar indicated a couple of rounds of
thunderstorms this evening had produced between 1.00 and 3.50
inches of heavy rain along and east of Route 15 between Santa Rosa
and North Komelik. The heaviest rainfall, between 2.50 and 3.50
inches, occurred near and east of North Komelik. Flash flooding is
ongoing, especially in normally dry washes and low-lying areas that
drain into the Santa Rosa Wash.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
urban areas, highways, streets and underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
North Komelik.

Anegam Wash, Sil Nakya Wash and Santa Rosa Wash.
properties.instruction:

deaths occur in vehicles.
